root_cause.text: The function `svc_rdma_copy_inline_range` does not validate that `rc_curpage` remains within the bounds of the allocated `rq_pages` array, leading to a potential out-of-bounds access when indexing `rqstp->rq_pages[rc_curpage]`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (head->rc_curpage >= rqstp->rq_maxpages) return -EINVAL;` before using `rc_curpage` as an index into `rqstp->rq_pages`, which was previously missing. The CVE description explicitly states the lack of verification.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add bounds check to prevent out-of-bounds access when copying inline RDMA data into pages.
intent_record.what: Added a guard condition at the start of each loop iteration in svc_rdma_copy_inline_range to check if head->rc_curpage is >= rqstp->rq_maxpages, and return -EINVAL if true.
intent_record.how: Prevents writing beyond the allocated page array by early returning with an error when the current page index exceeds the maximum allowed pages, avoiding potential memory corruption.
